adjudication.rationale: The new webhook handler uses a read-then-write pattern: `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId }})` followed by `credential.create(...)` when not found. As shown in the diff, there is no transaction/locking or `upsert`, so concurrent/retried webhooks could both observe “no row” and attempt a create. Whether that results in actual duplicate rows depends on DB uniqueness constraints (not shown in this diff), but the race risk and lack of conflict handling are real and diff-grounded.
